claim_scope: honest readiness gate for ref-only OrchestrationReasoning DPO pair bundle; no training, no checkpoint, no model asset

checks.name: required ref identity fields present
checks.evidence: pair_id, source_row_id, approved_pair_ref, error_code, chosen_ref, rejected_ref, source_ref, source_sha256 present on all rows

checks.name: manifest hashes match current files
checks.evidence: pairs and binding hashes match recorded manifests

checks.name: ORCH taxonomy refs present
checks.evidence: all error_code values use ORCH-* taxonomy refs

checks.name: raw private text not copied
checks.evidence: raw_private_text_copied=false on all rows; no raw private payload fields present

checks.name: technical execution refs excluded from trainable payload
checks.evidence: excluded_technical_execution_refs are refs only and technical_execution_leakage=false on all rows

checks.name: common/adaptive split preserved
checks.evidence: all materialized rows are model_leg=common; adaptive row remains deferred

checks.name: external AI and generated unreviewed negative text absent
checks.evidence: no external AI output or new generated chosen/rejected prose was introduced in this gate

checks.name: concrete chosen/rejected trainer payload exists
checks.evidence: rows contain chosen_ref/rejected_ref identifiers only; no concrete chosen/rejected feature contract or payload refs suitable for a trainer are present

tool_change_reason: not needed; static local schema/hash/readiness checks were sufficient to decide not-ready
next_action: author or materialize ref-only concrete chosen/rejected feature contracts for the existing approved pairs, without raw private text and without training
